title: Over Four Decades. One firm that handles all of it.
lead: ARSK & Associates is a Chartered Accountant firm established in 1984. We work with founders, promoters, family businesses, and multinationals navigating India's complex regulatory and commercial landscape — from day-to-day compliance to high-stakes transactions and disputes.
subtext: With professionals-led teams in Kolkata and Mumbai, and qualified professionals across audit, taxation, corporate law, and advisory, we bring the breadth of a large firm with the accountability of a practice where your partner picks up the phone.

pillars.title: Depth Without Complexity
pillars.text: We handle direct tax, indirect tax, international tax, audit, corporate law, valuations, and transaction advisory — all under one roof. You do not need to coordinate five different advisors. We handle the full picture.

pillars.title: Partner-Level Attention
pillars.text: Every engagement at ARSK is led by a qualified partner, not delegated down. With partners across disciplines and offices in Kolkata and Mumbai, you get senior judgment on your matters — not junior execution with partner sign-off.

pillars.title: Built for Indian Business Reality
pillars.text: Whether supporting a growing business, a regulated financial institution, a promoter group or an international investor, we bring an integrated perspective to complex tax, regulatory and transaction matters. Our experience extends across corporate restructurings, cross-border investments, governance, dispute support and strategic transactions.
